answer: Here is a specific defense: score token-distribution divergence against the identity's own answer history. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its ledge recurs, its ripple survives audit, and a jetty from an unlinked peer confirms it.
